purpose.zh: 轻轻拉开手腕和小臂里面
purpose.en: Gently stretches your wrist and the inside of your forearm.

text.zh: 手掌贴墙、手指朝上，身子慢慢往后靠
text.en: Palm on the wall, fingers up, slowly lean back

text.zh: 两脚站稳，手肘伸直别锁死。
text.en: Feet planted, elbow straight but soft.

text.zh: 手掌整个压在墙上，身子往后靠到小臂里面有拉就停。
text.en: Whole palm flat on the wall. Lean back until the inside of your forearm stretches.

text.zh: 别一下一下往下压，有一点拉就够，别使劲压墙。
text.en: Don't bounce. A gentle stretch is enough. Don't press hard into the wall.

commonErrors.en: Leaning your body weight onto your wrist.

commonErrors.zh: 手掌根离开墙，只剩手指贴着
commonErrors.en: Heel of your hand coming off the wall, only fingers touching.

cautions.zh: 手腕疼或手指发麻就停
cautions.en: Stop if your wrist hurts or your fingers tingle.
